"""Anonymous GET-only QA smoke; no cookies, tokens, uploads or model calls."""
import json
import subprocess

origin = 'https://anvil-qa.adi-labs.ai'
checks = {}
for name, path, expected in (
    ('health', '/api/v1/health', 200),
    ('workspace', '/workspace', 200),
    ('protected_templates', '/api/v1/projects/a7454c18-602e-4907-bdd9-277067c36233/dataset-exports/generic/templates', 401)):
    result = subprocess.run(['curl', '--silent', '--show-error', '--max-time', '20', '--location',
        '--write-out', '\n%{http_code}', origin + path], capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=25)
    body, separator, raw_status = result.stdout.rpartition(b'\n')
    assert separator
    status = int(raw_status)
    checks[name] = {'status': status, 'expected': expected, 'passed': status == expected}
    if name == 'health':
        checks[name]['data'] = json.loads(body)['data']
        assert all(checks[name]['data'][key] == value for key, value in (
            ('api', 'ready'), ('database', 'ready'), ('live_inference', 'disabled'), ('harbor_live_dispatch', 'disabled')))
assert all(value['passed'] for value in checks.values()), checks
print(json.dumps({'checks': checks, 'authenticated_ui_test': 'not_run_owner_browser_not_controlled', 'model_calls_authorized': 0}, sort_keys=True))
